description:
crate-jmap-mail-server/README.md says 'All 26 RFC 8621 method names'. True for what register_mail_handlers registers, but lib.rs *also* exports:

- `register_mdn_handlers` (RFC 9007: `MDN/send`, `MDN/parse`)
- `register_sieve_handlers` (RFC 9661: `SieveScript/get`, `…/set`, `…/query`, `…/validate`)

These are publicly available registration entry points that an integrator must find — they're silent in the README. Cargo features `mdn` and `sieve` gate them; the features themselves are undocumented in README (parallel to JMAP-sc1b.X for mail-types).

Fix: 'Registration' section should describe all three register_*_handlers entry points and call out which Cargo features gate which RFCs.
title: P2: mail-server README doesn't mention register_mdn_handlers or register_sieve_handlers
